title: Marketing Specialist, Nutraceuticals
description:
Job Title

Marketing Specialist, Nutraceuticals

Reporting To

Marketing Manager

Location

Remote - California based (10-25% estimated travel)

Work Schedule

Generally, M-F 8am to 5pm

FLSA Status

Full-time, Salaried Exempt

Compensation

The following information is provided in honesty as a general description of the salary range. The actual compensation offered to the successful candidate is dependent upon related factors such as, skills, experience, education, etc. Salary Range Estimate: $69,000 - $80,000 annually

Market Void

The current medicinal mushroom industry is split between low-quality producers and US cultivators with limited capabilities and product offerings. The industry is void of a low-cost, US-based producer that can offer a full medicinal mushroom product line (pure fruiting body and mycelium-based products) and that can serve as an unbiased, scientifically sound market educator and leader.

Opportunity

As the industry leader for over 50 years, Monterey Mushrooms has the production capacity, expertise, distribution network, R & D capability, and trusted brand to fill the market void and become the dominant global supplier of US-grown medicinal mushrooms.

Our Passion

We know mushrooms! From seed (spawn) to powder, we have control over every aspect of our business as we\'re a vertically integrated mushroom producer in North America. The spawn we use to grow our medicinal mushrooms is produced by our affiliate, Amycel SpawnMate. Then, we grow, dry, and package everything at our facilities in California to ensure our mushroom powders reach their full potential. If that is not enough, we third-party test for heavy metals, pesticides, mycotoxins, polysaccharides, and various compounds. In house, we test every product for potency, quality, and purity, and we have that verified by a third party periodically. Monterey Nutraceuticals is a portfolio company of Paine Schwarz Partners, who invested in the business in May 2022. For more information, visit us

Follow us on our socials!

Paine Schwartz Partners (PSP) is a global sustainable food-chain investment private equity firm based in California and New York. The firm invests in middle-market companies across North America and Europe. PSP is exclusively focused on investing in food and agribusiness companies and brings a collaborative and active management approach to its portfolio companies.

Over the past 20+ years, PSP (together with certain predecessor and related entities) has invested $5.7 billion of equity capital across 87 food and agribusiness investments (including 31 platform transactions), representing over $10.0 billion of total transaction value. Currently, the fund\'s portfolio is comprised of 17 food and ag companies and a total of $6.5 billion in AUM. PSP recently held its final closing for Fund VI at $1.7 billion, which was above its original target of $1.5 billion and 17% bigger than its previous $1.4 billion Fund V.

Of any industry, we believe food and agribusiness presents perhaps the greatest opportunity to simultaneously create value and drive positive impact through responsible investment practices. PSP is committed to addressing imminent challenges facing the food and agriculture sector by championing companies that provide innovative solutions around food security, economic growth, human rights, positive environmental impacts and health products. With an intensive focus on Sustainability & ESG, we are a proud signatory to the Principles for Responsible Investment, the global leading proponent of incorporating ESG factors in investment decisions and processes. To this end, these investments are deeply aligned with the United Nations Sustainable Development Goals (SDGs), such as zero hunger, clean water and sanitation and climate action, among many others. For more information on Paine Schwartz Partners, please visit

Why Join Our Organization?

Joining our company means stepping into a role where you can truly enhance people\'s lives while unlocking your own potential. Here, your ideas aren\'t just heard but valued, giving you the freedom to shape your career and create a meaningful impact every day. Seize the opportunity to be part of something extraordinary, where your personal growth drives our collective success and makes a lasting difference in the lives we touch.

What Do We Expect?

The Monterey Nutra Division is a fast-growing B2B business unit supplying premium mushroom ingredients—such as powders and extracts—for use in functional beverages, supplements, gummies, and more. Monterey Nutra is a subsidiary of Monterey Mushrooms and Amycel. We are looking for a highly motivated, professional, and adaptable Marketing Specialist to join our team remotely from California and able to travel regularly.

This position is ideal for someone who thrives in a fast-paced, ever-changing, entrepreneurial environment. You will play a hands-on role in executing marketing initiatives across a wide range of activities—from content creation, brand storytelling, and digital campaigns to light graphic design and strategic planning. The ideal candidate is organized, articulate, and confident in customer-facing and internal meetings, capable of juggling both creative and tactical marketing responsibilities.

We welcome candidates who embrace modern tools and technologies, including the responsible use of AI, to streamline marketing tasks, boost creativity, and increase efficiency across projects.

What are we looking for?

  • Execute marketing strategies and campaigns that support our B2B ingredient sales across nutraceutical, food, and beverage markets
  • Create and edit compelling content for digital and print-product sell sheets, presentations, web content, email campaigns, social media, blogs, etc.
  • Manage project timelines and marketing deliverables, keeping stakeholders informed and aligned
  • Support branding and storytelling efforts across our channels and customer touchpoints
  • Make graphic edits and manage basic design projects using Adobe Creative Suite
  • Assist in the development and delivery of presentation decks for internal and customer meetings
  • Liaise with sales, R&D, and executive teams to ensure marketing aligns with product capabilities and customer needs
  • Coordinate and track marketing activities and results across CRM, analytics, and internal systems
  • Support conference and trade show participation-pre-event prep, materials development, lead follow-up
  • Draft press releases and coordinate approvals, ensuring messaging aligns with brand and product goals; respond to media inquiries and support participation in earned media opportunities by preparing talking points and background materials.
  • Maintain organized marketing asset libraries (logos, images, templates, etc.).
  • Ensure timely and accurate updates to websites, email platforms, and social media.
  • Represent the Nutra division professionally during virtual or in-person meetings with customers and partners.
  • Participate in competitive analysis, customer research, and industry trend monitoring.
  • Create or assist in capturing and editing basic video or photo content.
  • Provide marketing support to adjacent departments or sister companies as needed.

Required Qualifications

  • Bachelor\'s degree in Marketing, Communications, Business, or a related field, preferably in Agriculture.
  • 3+ years of experience in a marketing role, preferably in B2B or ingredient/ food/ nutraceutical industries, or agricultural industries that relate such as fresh produce.
  • Strong writing, editing, and organizational skills.
  • Hands-on experience with social media, email marketing, and website updates.
  • Proficiency with Google Workspace (Docs, Sheets, Slides), Microsoft Office, and Adobe Creative Cloud (InDesign, Photoshop, Illustrator), Canva.
  • Experience with HubSpot or a similar marketing automation and CRM platform is preferred, as this role will support lead generation, email marketing, contact management, social media and reporting efforts within our marketing system.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience in food ingredients, supplements, beverages, or natural product sectors.
  • Familiarity with CRM systems and digital marketing platforms.
  • Light photography and video editing skills.
  • Passion for functional food and wellness categories.

Working with Agencies and Contractors

This role requires strong project management and communication skills to collaborate effectively with external marketing agencies, designers, freelance creatives, and other outside vendors. The Marketing Specialist will serve as a key point of contact, ensuring partners are aligned with brand guidelines, campaign objectives, and deadlines. From briefing creative teams to reviewing deliverables, this person will be responsible for driving projects forward, maintaining quality standards, and ensuring that all outsourced work supports the strategic goals of the Nutra division.

Travel, Trade Shows, and On-Site Content Capture

Weekly to monthly travel is required to support trade show participation and on-site marketing initiatives at our mushroom farms and production facilities. This includes coordinating and assisting with video and photo shoots, gathering behind-the-scenes content, and producing material for use in digital marketing, social media, and customer-facing platforms. The Marketing Specialist will be responsible for ensuring the content captured is consistent with brand storytelling and messaging while helping to document and showcase the people, processes, and products that set Monterey Mushrooms apart.

Descrição da empresa

A Eurofins Scientific é uma empresa internacional de ciências da vida que fornece uma gama única de serviços de testes analíticos para clientes em vários setores. O Grupo acredita que é o líder mundial em análises de produtos alimentícios e farmacêuticos, matrizes ambientais e em serviços de CRO de agrosciences. É também um dos líderes de mercados independentes globais para de certos testes e serviços laboratoriais para genômica, pesquisa farmacológica, ciência forense, ciências de materiais avançadas e para apoio a estudos clínicos. Além disso, a Eurofins é um dos principais players emergentes em testes de diagnóstico clínico especializados na Europa e nos EUA.

Os números-chave do grupo são aproximadamente: Faturamento de 3,8 bilhões de euros, mais de 800 laboratórios em 47 países e cerca de 45.000 funcionários.

Um dos nossos 7 valores é o “Sawabona", seu significado é pra lá de especial, e praticado diariamente aqui na Zappts!
A saudação #Sawabona se originou no Sul da África, onde se acredita que todos nascemos pessoas boas, mas que, às vezes, podemos cometer alguns erros.
Segundo a cultura deste lugar, quando alguém comete erros, toda a população se junta e, durante dois dias, só falam sobre as coisas boas que aquela pessoa já fez. Ao final desse período, todo o povo cumprimenta seu conterrâneo com a expressão "Sawabona".
Esse, por sua vez, responde "#Shikoba" . Sendo assim, Sawabona significa: "Eu te vejo, eu te respeito, você é importante para mim" . E a resposta, Shikoba: "Então eu sou bom e existo para você" .
Aqui na Zappts, Sawabona traduz e representa o que mais prezamos em nossas relações: o respeito e a valorização do outro.

By leveraging Upstart's AI marketplace, Upstart-powered banks and credit unions can have higher approval rates and lower loss rates across races, ages, and genders, while simultaneously delivering the exceptional digital-first lending experience their customers demand. More than 80% of borrowers are approved instantly, with zero documentation to upload.

Upstart is a digital-first company, which means that most Upstarters live and work anywhere in the United States. However, we also have offices in San Mateo, California; Columbus, Ohio; and Austin, Texas.

Most Upstarters join us because they connect with our mission of enabling access to effortless credit based on true risk. If you are energized by the impact you can make at Upstart, we’d love to hear from you!

The Team

Upstart is in a period of rapid growth and the People team is foundational to our continued success as we scale. You will be joining a company with engaged founders and leaders, strong values (practiced daily!) and operational rigor and discipline. Come help us build the culture that will enable continued success for our employees and our borrowers!

As an HR Business Partner supporting our Tech team, you will be responsible for day-to-day HR support to a critical talent population at Upstart. From front line manager coaching and talent development, to performance cycles and cultural initiatives, you will partner closely with the Lead HRBP and the Tech management team to uplevel performance and the employee experience at Upstart. You will also be a strategic HR Business Partner for our Auto GTM team, providing support to a key vertical team as they continue to scale.

As a member of our growing People org, you will participate in company-wide HR programs that could include initiatives in performance and talent management, employee engagement, system implementation, diversity and inclusion, development and more.

Position Location

Position Location - This role is available in the following locations: Remote

Travel Requirements

How you’ll make an impact

  • Coach and advisor: Advise and consult with managers and leaders as they continue to scale. From org design, to talent development, to rewards and recognition, and high performance culture, act as a trusted thought partner and coach.

  • Hitting and exceeding certain activation and revenue targets

Critical competencies

Experience

title: Sr Product Managment Manager - CIAM Strategy
description:
Overview

Position Overview: At PNC, our people are our greatest differentiator and competitive advantage in the markets we serve. We are united in delivering the best experience for our customers. We foster an inclusive workplace where all employees feel respected, valued and have an opportunity to contribute to the company’s success. As a Sr Product Management Manager within PNC’s Technology organization, you may be based in a remote location. This is a remote position. Work may be performed from a quiet, confidential space in a home location, approved by PNC. This position may not be available in all geographic locations.

PNC will not provide sponsorship for employment visas or participate in STEM OPT for this position

We are seeking a seasoned Product Manager to join our Enterprise Identity team, focused on Customer Identity and Access Management (CIAM) for our Commercial and Institutional Banking (C&IB) segments. This strategic role is critical to driving the modernization of our identity and authentication ecosystem, partnering closely with business line stakeholders to align digital identity strategy with C&IB goals.

In this role you will be part of the PNC’s Customer Identity and Access Management (CIAM) Team, which sits within PNC's Enterprise Technology & Security organization and is part of the PNC Enterprise Identity function. The ideal candidate will bring banking or financial services experience, strong leadership capabilities, and a proven ability to deliver complex identity solutions. You will serve as the CIAM product owner for C&IB, leading migration efforts to our new identity platform, defining KPIs/KRIs/OKRs, and managing a team of digital professionals to ensure secure, seamless, and scalable identity services.

The CIAM team is focused on creating enterprise Authentication and Identity Management capabilities that provide best in class authentication journeys for customers of PNC and the PNC’s Commercial and Institutional Banking Customers. The team is responsible for providing innovative products and capabilities in the areas of strong authentication, identity proofing, identity risk and decision management, single sign on, and federation to name a few. The team interacts and partners with line of business stakeholders, security partners and other functions to plan and coordinate capabilities and roadmaps.

The Role

The Product Manager is the Identity and Authentication SME and works closely with the Lines of Business to ensure alignment with vision, mission, and strategy. Our teams do operate under in a SAFE Agile environment, so familiarity with Scaled Agile Frameworks, ceremonies, responsibilities are a must.

Product Management is the function responsible for defining desirable, viable, feasible, and sustainable solutions that meet customer needs and supporting development across the product life cycle. Product Management works closely with the System Architect, Release Train Engineer, and Business Owners as leaders of the Agile Release Train (ART). Product Managers play a crucial role in aligning product strategy, vision, and roadmaps with customer needs and business objectives, fostering innovation and ensuring the delivery of valuable features. They manage and prioritize the ART backlog, collaborate with cross-functional teams, and leverage the continuous delivery pipeline to release value in response to market needs.

Product Management is responsible for leading product strategy, vision, and road mapping across the ART. Product Managers bridge the gap between customer desires, market trends, and organizational capabilities.

Responsibilities

  • Product Leadership: Own the CIAM product strategy and roadmap for Commercial & Institutional Banking; align platform capabilities to B2B user needs and regulatory expectations.
  • Stakeholder Alignment: Serve as the primary liaison to C&IB line of business leaders; drive collaboration to align identity solutions with business goals and customer journeys.
  • Identity Platform Modernization: Lead planning, migration, and integration efforts to onboard C&IB applications to our modernized identity platform.
  • Metrics & Measurement: Define and manage KRIs, KPIs, and OKRs for C&IB identity programs; establish data reporting and insights capabilities to measure and inform decisions.
  • Team Leadership: Lead a cross-functional team of digital identity professionals including engineers, analysts, and project leads; foster accountability, innovation, and continuous improvement.
  • Governance & Compliance: Ensure CIAM solutions meet internal security policies, external regulatory requirements (e.g., FFIEC, NIST), and support audit-readiness.
  • Communication & Change Management: Develop and deliver clear communications and presentations to technical and non-technical stakeholders; support change management across business and technology teams.
  • Drive automation and self-service enablement functions to simplify onboarding and increase usage of the platform.
  • Partner with technology development and solution design architecture SMEs to assess current capabilities, business architecture and go-forward strategic architecture for commercial user authentication.
  • Identifying business outcomes and OKRs for user authentication; define capability priorities, secure funding, manage the backlog and build reporting/analytics to measure success.
  • Work collaboratively across businesses / functional areas to define, sequence, and execute the enterprise roadmap for new identity management features and vendor relationships.
  • Support the development of strategy and initiatives involving federated, centralized and decentralized authentication opportunities.

Qualifications and Requirements

Preferred Experience : 7+ years in product management, digital identity, or cybersecurity roles; Banking/financial services or B2B digital platforms experience; proven identity migrations or enterprise-scale platform transitions.

Skills : Strong understanding of CIAM, identity federation, MFA, authentication protocols (OIDC, SAML), and risk-based authentication; excellent communication, stakeholder management, and presentation skills; ability to manage and mentor cross-functional teams; analytical mindset with metrics experience.

Education : Bachelor’s degree in Information Systems, Business, or related field (Master’s preferred).

Additional Qualifications : Experience with identity provider migrations (PING, Transmit); familiarity with FIDO standards; strong product management, design and development skills; ability to lead and develop a team; change management capabilities; strategic communication with executive presence; experience developing multi-year identity management and risk management strategy.

Compensation and Benefits

Pay Transparency: Base Salary: $80,000.00 – $202,150.00. Salaries may vary based on location, market data and on individual skills, experience, and education. This role is incentive eligible.

Benefits include medical/dental/vision, life insurance, disability protection, 401(k) with company match, pension and stock purchase plans, dependent care, adoption/reimbursement programs, educational assistance, wellness programs and paid time off. See Total Rewards for details.

Additional Information

Application Window: Generally posted for two business days from 07/24/2025, may be longer at discretion. Disability accommodations available. EEO: PNC provides equal employment opportunity to qualified persons regardless of protected status. FDIA/SAFE/FINRA compliance applies where required. California Residents: refer to California Privacy Notice for hiring practices.

We revisit compensation annually (and more often for graduates and associates) to ensure we recognize outstanding performance. title: HEINEKEN UK Supply Chain Opportunities
description:
External Advert

Supply Chain Opportunities

As the UK’s leading beer, cider and pub business, we’re home to some of the world’s best-loved beers and ciders , and a leading player in the international drinks industry.

We're the name behind a host of brilliant brands, from Inch’s to Birra Moretti and many more. And with around 2,400 pubs to our name in the UK, our Star Pubs business is all about putting pubs at the centre of community life.

But we’re more than just great beers and ciders – we’re a place where passion meets purpose, careers are crafted as carefully as our brews, and enjoyment of life is part of the job.

We’ll soon be recruiting for multiple roles across our production sites in Manchester, Tadcaster, and Herefordshire. We’re searching for passionate people who want to grow and develop their skills, gain hands-on experience with a wide range of technologies, sharpen their problem-solving abilities and untap their full potential.

What roles will be available?

If you're interested in joining our Supply Chain team but don't see a role below that's right for you, we’d still love to hear from you.

Maintenance Managers

The role: Leading and coaching maintenance teams to ensure asset reliability, safety compliance, and smooth daily operations. You’ll oversee maintenance planning, CMMS use, and budgets for packaging lines.

Who we’re looking for: Strong leaders who can implement new ways of working, challenge existing practices and lead teams through change. Experience with complex process control systems, continuous improvement mindset, IOSH or NEBOSH qualification, and TPM knowledge are essential.

Maintenance Development Engineers

The role: Develop and implement maintenance strategies across Production, Packaging, and Utilities. You’ll lead improvement projects, support technicians with breakdown analysis, optimise maintenance standards, manage change and handle investment proposals.

Who we’re looking for: Experience with high-speed process or packaging machinery, preferably in FMCG. You’ll be skilled in maintenance techniques such as FMECA and RCM, problem-solving with LEAN or TPM, and able to drive improvements collaboratively.

Automation Engineers

The role: Supporting and maintaining automation and electrical systems across production and utilities. Key systems include Rockwelland Siemens PLCs, SCADA platforms, and various industrial networks. Your focus will be on improving reliability, efficiency and performance.

Who we’re looking for: You’ll have an Electrical Engineering qualification (NVQ Level 3 to HNC/HND) with solid electrical knowledge. Experience with Rockwell and Siemens PLCs, SCADA, industrial networks, and cybersecurity is required. FMCG and packaging automation experience is preferred, plus you’ll also have great communication and training skills.

Technicians

The role: Performing essential maintenance and quality tasks to ensure the safe and efficient operation of equipment. You’ll be driving continuous improvement on a fast-paced, automated production line.

Who we’re looking for: You’ll preferably have some FMCG background, be skilled in mechanical and electrical maintenance, proactive in continuous improvement and be a natural team player. Relevant qualifications like HND, NVQ Level 3, or nearing Apprenticeship completion are desired.

Why join us?

We're all about brewing the Joy of True Togetherness, and that starts with our people.

We believe in bringing everyone together, making sure you feel supported, valued, and included from day one – because every one of our colleagues has a role to play in shaping the future of beer, cider, pubs and beyond.

It’s a brilliant time to join us. We’re pioneering in low and no alcohol products, continuing to wow the world with creative marketing campaigns, investing into pubs and brewing a better world for people and the planet.

We're a place where you can build a meaningful career, with plenty of opportunities for continuous learning and development. Our Upskill-Reskill programme makes sure you have the capabilities you need both now and in the future, while our in-house platform, UBrew, is packed with learning resources. For those just starting out or looking for a career change, our apprenticeships let you earn valuable qualifications while you work. And for our managers and leaders, our LEAD talent programme provides the tools and guidance to inspire drive long-term success.

So, whether you're just starting out or ready for your next challenge, here's your chance to step up, raise the bar and brew a great career.

Check out the hashtag #LifeAtHEINEKENUK on LinkedIn to hear directly from our people.

Our benefits

Here’s a flavour of what we offer:

  • Annual bonus
  • Double matched pension (up to 10%)
  • 32 days’ holiday, plus three listed public holidays (Christmas Day, Boxing Day, and New Year's Day – if any of these fall on a weekend, you'll get the following weekday off instead)
  • Life assurance (subject to policy terms)
  • Critical illness insurance – comprehensive cover for you and your family
  • Free ciders and beers (including low and zero alcohol options)
  • Retail discounts
  • Comprehensive opportunities to develop
  • The chance to join our colleague networks, where you can help us continue to build a diverse and inclusive workplace
  • …and much more!

Please note: Rewards and benefits can vary from role to role. Some benefits are taxable and may be based on employee contributions. We’re happy to discuss further throughout the application process.

The application

If you’re interested in this opportunity, please apply by submitting your CV along with a cover letter indicating which role(s) you’re interested in. We’d love to know why you believe you’re the right candidate to help us build on our success and shape the future!

You might not meet every single requirement for the roles listed above, and that’s okay – we all need the opportunity to develop and untap our full potential. If this advert’s piqued your interest, we’d encourage you to apply rather than ruling yourself out. You never know – you may be exactly what we’re looking for!

If you need any adjustments made to support your application (for example, if you require information in different formats, or if you have any accessibility issues), we’re more than happy to review our processes – please feel free to get in touch with us as .

Please note that you must have legal right to work in the UK .

Who we are

We’ve more than 150 years of brewing history and are proud of this legacy. Yet we’re sure our best days are ahead of us. Every one of our colleagues has a role to play as we dream big, set bold ambitions and push the boundaries.

Apply today to discover Your Future, Untapped.

title: ANALISTA DE AUDITORIA SÊNIOR
description:
Quem somos

Na Qive, simplificamos o complexo para impulsionar o crescimento das empresas no Brasil. Transacionamos mais de 3,8 bilhões de notas fiscais e conectamos mais de 140 mil empresas, criando um elo poderoso entre o fiscal e o financeiro. Desde o início, projetamos soluções digitais que revolucionam o dia a dia das pessoas e empresas, sempre com a missão de tornar processos complexos mais simples, eficientes e eficazes. Sonhamos grande e agimos rápido, enfrentando desafios com entusiasmo e transformando problemas em oportunidades. Valorizamos o trabalho em equipe, a colaboração e o senso de urgência, sempre buscando a excelência em nossas entregas. Aqui, cada pessoa, seja cliente, líder ou colega, desempenha um papel essencial no nosso sucesso coletivo. Na Qive, estamos comprometidos em mudar a forma como o mercado se relaciona com Documentos Fiscais Eletrônicos (DFes), reduzindo horas operacionais, conomizando custos e mitigando riscos. Nossa cultura é orientada pela inovação, responsabilidade e agilidade, sempre com o objetivo de liderar o mercado e oferecer soluções que impulsionem o crescimento de nossos clientes. Venha fazer parte dessa revolução e seja o nosso elo para ajudar a construir um futuro mais simples e descomplicado para as empresas brasileiras!

Responsabilidades e objetivos da vaga

  • Estruturar e Executar o Plano de Auditoria Integrada: Mapear processos ponta a ponta (financeiros, operacionais e de TI) para avaliar a adequação e a eficácia dos controles internos com base nos frameworks COSO (controles internos) e COBIT (governança de TI), com foco especial nos fluxos transacionais e de configuração operados no SAP B1.
  • Conduzir Testes de Controles e Substantivos: Desenvolver e executar programas de testes de auditoria para avaliar a integridade dos registros contábeis e a segurança dos sistemas de informação, incluindo testes de Controles Gerais de TI (ITGCs), validação de configurações e análise de dados para identificar anomalias.
  • Reportar Achados e Acompanhar Planos de Ação: Elaborar relatórios de auditoria claros e objetivos, comunicando deficiências, riscos e recomendações, e trabalhar com as áreas de negócio para desenvolver e acompanhar a implementação dos planos de ação.
  • Atuar como Consultor de Riscos e Controles: Oferecer suporte na análise de riscos de novos projetos, processos e sistemas, garantindo que os controles sejam desenhados de forma eficaz desde a concepção (compliance and security by design).

Requisitos

  • Experiência híbrida em auditoria: experiência em auditoria interna ou externa, com atuação em auditoria de processos contábeis/financeiros e em auditoria de sistemas e ITGC.
  • Domínio de Frameworks de Controle: conhecimento de COSO e COBIT para controles internos e governança de TI.
  • Conhecimento em ERP e Processos Contábeis: sólida base contábil e experiência prática com ERP, com destaque para SAP B1, entendendo módulos, tabelas e fluxos de dados.
  • Perfil Analítico e Comunicação Efetiva: capacidade analítica, detalhista, e habilidade de apresentar achados de forma clara para públicos técnicos e não técnicos.

Pontos a mais se você possui

  • Habilidades em Análise de Dados (CAATs): domínio de SQL e Python para auditoria assistida por computador, manipulação de grandes volumes de dados e automação de testes.
  • Conhecimento em Normas Contábeis Específicas e Segurança da Informação: familiaridade com planos de contas setoriais (COSIF), LGPD e ISO 27001.
  • Certificações Profissionais: CIA, CISA ou outras correlatas.

Benefícios

  • Plano de saúde Unimed com cobertura nacional, sem desconto de mensalidade para nossos Qivers e filhos;
  • Plano odontológico com cobertura nacional, sem descontos e com possibilidade de inclusão de dependentes;
  • Benefício Flash Flex para alimentação, mobilidade, bem-estar, saúde, educação, cultura e entretenimento;
  • Programa de Participação nos Resultados (PPR) competitivo;
  • Licenças estendidas (maternidade/paternidade, inclusive para adoção e casais homoafetivos);
  • Ajuda de custo nos primeiros meses após nascimento ou adoção;
  • Auxílio creche ou babá para filhos de até 6 anos;
  • Total Pass; Cartão Alelo Multibenefícios; Seguro de vida.

E mais

  • Trabalho remoto, liberdade geográfica em qualquer lugar do país; envio de equipamentos para montar seu escritório em casa ou sede com estacionamento gratuito.
  • Ambiente de aprendizado, desenvolvimento constante, feedbacks e trabalho em equipe;
  • Bem-estar: aulas online de Yoga, Meditação e Ginástica Laboral;
  • Parcerias para saúde mental e aprendizado (Ana Health, Vamos Escrever, Cambly).

Diversidade e Privacidade

Diversidade é aprendizado e inclusão é necessária na Qive. Garantimos liberdade e respeito para falar, ouvir e sentir as experiências positivas da empresa, independentemente de crença, gênero, orientação sexual, cor de pele, deficiência ou classe social.

Privacidade dos Dados Pessoais: coletamos dados fornecidos no formulário de candidatura e no currículo, para identificação, comunicação e análise das candidaturas. Utilizamos o sistema InHire para gestão de vagas. Em dúvidas, consulte nossa Política de Privacidade.

Localização

Cachoeirinha, Rio Grande do Sul, Brazil

Join to apply for the Online Data Analyst - Fully Remote Position role at TELUS Digital AI Data Solutions

  • Work at the cutting edge of Webflow, Wized, and CRO innovation.

HR Professional | Passionate about Culture, Growth & People

Who We Are

ENG (engbim.com) is a BIM company that specializes in hands-on, field-focused BIM services. Founded in 2007, we have positioned ourselves as the largest and most experienced BIM production service provider in the United States, having completed 5,000 BIM projects with a dedicated team of over 600 staff members. We provide MEP Modeling, VDC/BIM Management, Laser Scanning, and Scan to BIM services, as well as a comprehensive array of BIM production services to architects, engineers, and owners.

The Role

The BIM Specialist role generally involves covering the modeling of different trades (MEP), depending on your background and expertise, whose extent will depend on the scope of the project (specific zones or entire buildings), and whose quality will go according to clients’ requirements and the services provided by the team you end up joining. This position requires a high level of modeling quality (expertise, technical knowledge, LOD and QAQC capabilities), and more autonomy in its self-management and modeling capabilities (studying whatever's necessary according to each trade). A BIM Specialist saves the client problems, detecting possible conflicts throughout the initial information review and the modeling and coordination phases.

Minimum mandatory requirements include:

  • An excellent level of English is an absolute must, both spoken and written . Aspiring candidates must be able to keep up with fluent conversations both with native and non-native speakers. Candidates without this requirement will NOT be considered .
  • Solid experience modeling HVAC and plumbing in Revit for commercial, industrial, healthcare, and residential construction . This can include things like process piping , ductwork and sheet metal , and mechanical equipment (pumps , AHUs , RTUs , chillers and boilers ), and for plumbing, domestic water , sanitary drainage and gray water , stormwater , medical gases , compressed air lines , pumps , heaters and hangers .
  • Experience coordinating or clash-detecting through Navisworks (Revizto can also be considered but Navisworks will be prioritized), knowledge of BIM coordination, clash report , QAQC and model accuracy .
  • A mechanical or civil engineering bachelors degree (architects could be considered but only if they have extensive experience modeling and coordinating MEP trades themselves).

Specific requirements will vary depending on the position and service. Experience with Level Of Detail (LOD) 400 and projects based in the US , or constructability knowledge related to that country will be a huge differential . Other desirable requirements are:

  • Familiarity with BIM add-ins (e.g., Evolve , SysQue , Fabrication Parts ).
  • Experience in conceptual design / BIM Design assist.
  • AutoCAD Plant 3D knowledge.
  • Dynamo/Python knowledge applied to BIM .
  • On-site/field experience .
  • Ability to produce detailed models, including real-world fittings and connection types .

Please know if you don't have experience working with Revit in formal jobs, it will be hard to consider your profile. Please DON'T apply if you don't have the necessary English level.

No-Policy for PTO: Recharge with flexible paid time off when you need it.

Monthly Internet Allowance: Stay connected with a monthly allowance for internet and expenses.

Highly Competitive Compensation Package: Includes both fixed and variable payments, all processed in our local currency, USD.

Join us and grow in a flexible, innovative environment!

Compensation will be in USD, competitive and commensurate with experience.

description:
About Acadia Pharmaceuticals

Acadia is advancing breakthroughs in neuroscience to elevate life. Since our founding, we have been working at the forefront of healthcare to bring vital solutions to people who need them most. We developed and commercialized the first and only FDA-approved drug to treat hallucinations and delusions associated with Parkinson's disease psychosis, and the first and only approved drug in the United States and Canada for the treatment of Rett syndrome. Our clinical-stage development efforts are focused on Prader-Willi syndrome, Alzheimer's disease psychosis, and multiple other programs targeting neuro-psychiatric and neuro-rare diseases. For more information, visit Acadia.com and follow us on LinkedIn and X.

Seeking talent near: Chicago, IL; Naperville, IL

Position Summary

The Neuroscience Sales Specialist is responsible for achieving sales goals within the assigned territory by building strong customer relationships, delivering compliant and compelling product education, and driving appropriate patient access. This role requires expertise in neuroscience, deep knowledge of the local healthcare landscape, and the ability to partner effectively with healthcare professionals (HCPs) and key stakeholders to deliver meaningful value and service.

Primary Responsibilities

  • Promote Acadia products to HCPs in person and virtually, providing clinical, disease state, and reimbursement information in a compliant and customer-focused manner.

  • Accurately track and report sales activities, business expenses, and customer interactions in a timely manner.
  • Represent Acadia at conferences, exhibits, and trainings; participate in national, regional, and local meetings as required.
  • Mentor and train new sales specialists as needed, and contribute to cross-functional projects and field strategic insights.

Knowledge & Expertise

  • Deep understanding of neuroscience disease states, Acadia products, and local/regional market dynamics.
  • Ability to serve as a trusted resource in the medical community.
  • Proficiency in Microsoft Office and virtual engagement platforms (e.g., Zoom, WebEx).
  • Strong grasp of payer dynamics, including Part D and specialty pharmacy/hub distribution.

Qualifications

  • Education: Bachelor's degree required; life sciences preferred.
  • Experience:
    • Sales Specialist : Minimum 1+ years of sales experience in pharmaceutical/healthcare; neuroscience preferred.

  • Must reside within the territory (or within 30 miles of its border) and possess a valid driver's license with an acceptable driving record.
  • Ability to meet travel requirements, including significant driving and overnight stays; air travel as needed.
  • Must comply with vaccination requirements for HCP office access, long-term care facilities, and medical conferences.

Scope

Applies broad experience and professional judgment to address complex business challenges, using creativity and data-driven decision-making to achieve results in a highly regulated environment.

Physical Requirements

This role involves regular standing, walking, sitting, and the use of hands for handling or operating equipment. The employee may also need to reach, climb, balance, stoop, kneel, crouch, and maintain visual, verbal, and auditory communication both in a standard office environment and while working independently from remote locations. Employee must occasionally lift and/or move up to 20 pounds. This position requires the ability to travel independently overnight and/or work after hours as required by travel schedule or business needs. Must reside within the territory (or within 30 miles of its border) and, depending on territory needs, within reasonable proximity to a major airport. Requires eligibility to drive a company vehicle and ability to travel independently by air. Travel may be up to 80% of the time, including occasional after-hours work based on business needs.

description:
Sobre a Dreamland Holding

Já pensou em editar conteúdos para marcas que estão entre as mais promissoras do Brasil?

A Dreamland Holding é uma holding empresarial que abriga duas empresas em plena ascensão:

  • Dream Success : Eleita a 86ª startup mais potencial do Brasil. Especializada em neurociência aplicada a negócios, programas de aceleração e formação de empreendedores de alta performance.
  • Conface Contabilidade : Escritório contábil premiado pela sua abordagem disruptiva e consultiva. Oferecendo uma contabilidade estratégica, moderna e centrada no sucesso dos clientes.

Nosso objetivo é formar talentos que queiram crescer junto com o grupo, desenvolvendo uma carreira comercial sólida e com potencial real de liderança.

Se você é resiliente a pressão, ágil na edição, profissional, domina as ferramentas de edição e está pronto(a) para assumir demandas recorrentes com padrão elevado de entrega, essa oportunidade é para sua empresa!

Sobre a vaga

Buscamos um(a) editor(a) com experiência profissional na edição de vídeos curtos (formato Reels, Shorts, TikTok) com foco em cortes criativos e estilo viral.

O material bruto será enviado pela equipe estratégica e sua responsabilidade será realizar a edição completa, com cortes dinâmicos, inserção de legendas, memes e elementos visuais conforme o brand book das marcas. Bem como, elaborar a thumbnail com mockups existentes no Canva Pro.

Os vídeos são enviados toda segunda-feira, e a entrega final precisa ser feita ao longo da semana conforme agenda proposta. Fique atento que somos bastante rígidos ao cumprimento de SLAs.

Requisitos obrigatórios

  • Experiência comprovada com edição de vídeos curtos e virais para redes sociais;
  • Portfólio profissional obrigatório (anexar no campo de currículo);
  • Domínio avançado em edições de vídeos profissionais, com usabilidade de Premiere Pro e After Effects;
  • Domínio avançado em edições de vídeos profissionais, com aplicação de motion design;
  • Domínio avançado em Canva Pro (edição de capa de vídeos, thumbnails, etc.);
  • Conhecimento avançado em Google Workspace;
  • Excelente senso estético, atenção a tendências visuais e replicação EXATA ao estilo da marca;
  • Capacidade de seguir referências com precisão e respeitar o brand book;
  • Equipamento próprio e softwares por conta do prestador (empresa não fornece);
  • Perfil ágil, comprometido e que cumpre prazos.

Diferenciais que avaliaremos

  • Experiência PROFISSIONAL com edição para influenciadores, startups ou marcas com conteúdo digital estratégico;
  • Conhecimento em branding visual e adaptação de diferentes linguagens visuais;
  • Habilidade com legendas dinâmicas, memes e cortes no estilo “corte podcast”.

Modelo de contratação

  • Pessoa Jurídica (PJ);
  • Pagamento por hora trabalhada, com rastreamento automático via nosso sistema de controle interno;
  • A empresa remunera inclusive os minutos trabalhados, de forma transparente e justa;
  • Valor hora negociado entre as partes no momento da contratação;
  • Faturamento realizado até o quinto dia útil do mês subsequente;
  • Liberdade de horário : você define sua agenda, desde que cumpra os prazos de entrega;

Importante :

Essa é uma vaga para profissionais com know-how técnico.

Pedimos que não se candidatem pessoas sem experiência comprovada com motion design, vídeos curtos, cortes virais e linguagem visual para redes sociais. Por exemplo, ter apenas um conhecimento em CapCut não nos atende nesta vaga em específico. Precisamos de um editor profissional.

A qualidade da entrega será exigida desde o primeiro job, pois atuamos com padrão elevado nas três marcas do grupo.

Exemplos de entregas que esperamos de sua parte

Venha fazer parte de um time criativo, inovador e que acredita na excelência como diferencial!

Se você tem o perfil técnico, envie agora sua candidatura com portfólio anexo no campo de currículo.

You will combine technical expertise with leadership in documentation, collaborating with colleagues across the company to establish documentation as a first-class engineering discipline. Even the most junior Technical Authors will have the opportunity to develop and demonstrate technical authority.
As well as your role in an engineering team, you will also be a part of Canonical's documentation practice team, that includes all the company's Technical Authors. Here, you'll be amongst other documentation experts, who collaborate to define documentation excellence and drive the development of documentation practice and theory, across the company and in the open-source software community.
Location: These are fully remote roles, open to candidates across the globe.
The role entails

  • Create, maintain and improve software documentation
  • Work with engineering team members, to help them make effective documentation contributions
  • Influence the development of the product, as an expert user of the product, who has important opinions about its function and design
  • Engage with user communities to ensure that our documentation meets their needs
  • Encourage and support community engagement in and contribution to documentation
  • Help standardise the structure, presentation, style and language of content across products
  • Collaborate with documentation peers to advance the state of the art in documentation at Canonical
  • Challenge and advance documentation understanding and best-practice, as part of a disciplinary team
What we are looking for in you
  • Cares deeply about functional written communication
  • Is a technical writer with a programmer's mindset, or a programmer with a record of producing excellent documentation
  • Has a record of community engagement, in open-source software, documentation, research or other disciplines
  • Is sympathetic to the needs and challenges of open-source software and its communities
  • Demonstrates technical curiosity, and is fascinated by software technology and its challenges
  • Has demonstrable documentation skills, insight and enthusiasm
  • Has experience of software development contexts; is familiar with: Linux, working on the command line, application deployment, system operations, and infrastructure management, Git, documentation markup languages
  • Has excellent written and verbal communication skills
  • Holds a BSc/BA degree or equivalent
  • Is able to travel twice a year for up to two weeks for events
Nice-to-have skills
  • Deep technical domain knowledge
  • Open-source community leadership and management
  • User-experience, interaction or visual design
What we offer you
We consider geographical location, experience, and performance in shaping compensation worldwide. We revisit compensation annually (and more often for graduates and associates) to ensure we recognise outstanding performance. In addition to base pay, we offer a performance-driven annual bonus or commission. We provide all team members with additional benefits, which reflect our values and ideals. We balance our programs to meet local needs and ensure fairness globally.
  • Distributed work environment with twice-yearly team sprints in person
  • Personal learning and development budget of USD 2,000 per year
  • Annual compensation review
  • Recognition rewards
  • Annual holiday leave
  • Maternity and paternity leave
  • Employee Assistance Programme
  • Opportunity to travel to new locations to meet colleagues
  • Priority Pass, and travel upgrades for long haul company events
About Canonical
Canonical is a pioneering tech firm at the forefront of the global move to open source. As the company that publishes Ubuntu, one of the most important open source projects and the platform for AI, IoT and the cloud, we are changing the world of software. We recruit on a global basis and set a very high standard for people joining the company. We expect excellence - in order to succeed, we need to be the best at what we do. Most colleagues at Canonical have worked from home since its inception in 2004. Working here is a step into the future, and will challenge you to think differently, work smarter, learn new skills, and raise your game.
Canonical is an equal opportunity employer
We are proud to foster a workplace free from discrimination. Diversity of experience, perspectives, and background create a better work environment and better products. Whatever your identity, we will give your application fair consideration.

description:

We’re looking for a results-driven and experienced Ecommerce Manager to join our team. As an Ecommerce Manager at Common Thread Collective (CTC), you will be instrumental in driving client success through strategic media buying, precision optimization, and data-driven forecasting. You will lead the development of accurate, insight-driven forecasts, ensuring that every strategy is executed seamlessly to transform projections into tangible, scalable growth for our clients. Your actions and decisions consistently resonate with the core values of CTC Global, serving as a beacon for these principles. At CTC, your trained expertise is invaluable, covering the entire spectrum of CTC’s Strategic Forecasting methods and the foundational principles of media acquisition.

Your role goes beyond delivering measurable business outcomes—you will be a proactive partner in client success, maintaining clear and transparent communication about performance, strategy adjustments, and key optimizations. This continuous dialogue builds trust, strengthens partnerships, and positions CTC as a strategic ally, guiding clients through the intricacies of media acquisition and growth planning. At CTC, you set the benchmark for performance marketing, advocating for best-in-class strategies and tools to drive unparalleled results. As an Ecommerce Manager, you set a high standard, ensuring efficiency, scalability, and a results-focused approach.

You view challenges as opportunities to excel and take great pride in your ability to drive results with precision and impact. At CTC, we embrace the mantra, “Everyday in Everyplay, Count on Me,” meaning we take ownership, deliver excellence, and see things through to the end.

WHAT WE LOOK FOR

This place isn’t for everyone, but it might be for you if…

Our core values are the heart and soul of this incredible Company. The right person for this role will appreciate each of these values, personally subscribe to them, and understand why each is critical to having a great business. To give ourselves our best shot at accomplishing Our mission, we organize all of our decisions—from recruiting, to hiring, to raises, to promotions, to how we spend our time and money—in the direction of three committed values. We recognize these values aren’t for everyone. They’re challenging. In fact, they’re so challenging, that’s why we invest so much in supporting our team and why we tend to attract people who are craving the opportunity to do more at work than get a paycheck. We’re looking for those who are interested in making their work significant.

AUTODIDACT

  • Naturally curious and an autodidact, able to absorb information quickly and effectively, like osmosis. Your commitment to learning sets you apart, absorbing information swiftly and more effectively than your peers.

  • Demonstrates resourcefulness, and independently refine your skills without being prompted.
  • Thrives in a self-managed environment, showing autonomy, initiative, and a commitment to continuous improvement and not requiring task lists built by their managers and constant oversight.

UNIMPEACHABLE CHARACTER

  • Embodies a character that inspires pride in both personal and professional associations.

COMPETITIVE GREATNESS

What Success Looks Like

NECESSARY SKILLS

KICK OFF PERIOD

  • Perseverance.
  • Remember and learn from the repetitive doing of the exercises.

ONBOARDING

  • Align with the team and contribute to the team called Brain Trust for Ideas across clients.

  • Ability to organize, prioritize, and manage multiple tasks with great attention to detail.
  • Upkeep of data integrity of your clients across Statlas.
  • Be responsible for the execution of the Prophet system for your clients
  • Building a Growth Forecast for your clients
    • Building a Growth map using the Prophet System
    • Data Analysis required for the Map
    • Marketing calendar alignment and upkeep with clients
  • The Daily Execution and Actualisation vs the Forecast.
    • You make tactical deconstructions and actualize the projections each day to adjust them to meet KPIs
  • Combine data analysis and feedback from clients to develop strategic plans for the future.
  • When it’s time to pivot you are among the first early adopters
  • Take a lead in situations that present any obstacle to execution.
  • An insatiable curiosity, and an inability to leave a problem alone until you’ve found one or many different potential solutions.
  • Responsible for the implementation of CTC’s Meta best practices
  • Build campaigns using our structure and best practices
  • Upkeep and management of our ideologies and processes throughout the account.
  • Monitoring active campaigns, and adjusting budgets and strategy to ensure the best possible chance of hitting the Daily Projected Targets
  • Implementing tests in your accounts in an effort to beat your best-performing campaigns.

ENSURING AND HOLDING THE STANDARD OF QUALITY OF WORK

  • Ensuring you are within a 5% Delta to the Forecast
  • Ensuring daily alignment with the client vs the forecast & strategy
  • Ensuring following the Prophet system execution to 100% within the timeline required.

  • You are a champion of communication, ensuring the client is aligned on the Growth Map goals and next steps, while making sure everybody on your team has clarity on what is required with exact deadlines.
  • Responsible for sending daily performance updates to the client
  • Ensure alignment across Strategy and Forecast with the client for every day of the week.
  • Providing weekly updates on the Weekly Strategy Call.

CONTRIBUTING BACK

  • Contributing your learnings back to the system for feedback and continuous improvement
  • Contributing & collaborating in ideas and learning across teams
  • Contributing to ideas and learning in future company content production.

NEXT-LEVEL SKILLS

  • Fluent in English, with a proven ability to communicate persuasively and present ideas clearly to various stakeholders.
  • Skilled in crafting thoughtful, empathetic client messaging that resonates, demonstrating a high level of emotional intelligence.

  • Strong raw talent for data analysis, with an eagerness to learn and improve.
  • Familiarity with data tools, including Google Sheets, with the flexibility to develop advanced skills through on-the-job experience.

Past Experience

  • Historical expertise that compounds to bring a well-rounded perspective and adds value to the role.
  • A breadth of experience from any of the multiple domains, including mathematics, data analytics, business operations, retail, finance, media buying, etc

Critical Thinking

  • Ability to approach challenges with structured thinking, utilizing logical frameworks to effectively solve complex problems.
  • Naturally adept at dissecting issues and proposing practical, impactful solutions.

Impact

  • Passionate about e-commerce and eager to contribute to a high-performing team at the forefront of the industry.
  • Highly motivated and hardworking, with a strong desire to learn, grow, and make a meaningful impact.
  • Thrives in environments where they can see the direct results of their actions on the business, with a strong preference for roles that offer full accountability and autonomy.

Results

You will merge the Finance and Marketing sides of a business to build a forecasted strategy to help the business achieve its goal.

  • Achieve certification and confidence in our ideology by the end of training, enabling precise execution of the Prophet system to ensure top-quality results for clients.
  • Consistently deliver high-accuracy performance within a 5% delta across the Prophet system’s Growth Map and Statlas.
  • Lead and collaborate with your team to optimize productivity and maintain high-performance standards.
  • Apply best practices in media buying to drive outstanding results, ensuring no one could achieve better outcomes in your role.
  • Maintain client satisfaction levels above benchmark rates, aligning daily on forecasts to exceed client expectations.
  • Adhere to rigorous quality standards in client feedback, forecasting, media buying decisions, and system execution.
  • Meet all deadlines and budget requirements, ensuring timely and on Target Performance.
  • Contribute valuable ideas to team discussions and company-wide content, supporting growth and innovation.

DOMAIN

MANAGEMENT

  • Your supervisor would be Joy Sharma, The Director of the CTC Accelerator Program.
  • You’ll report directly to Joy Sharma —a leader known for his relentless pursuit of excellence and an unmatched passion for growth strategy. Joy is a rare mentor, often described as the closest you’ll come to learning directly from Taylor Holiday himself. With a career built on his own rigorous, self-driven learning, Joy has transformed numerous team members into top-tier strategists, instilling in them the values of dedication, precision, and continuous improvement.

Working under Joy's guidance will push you to your limits in the best possible way. He models the value of hard work, and learning from him feels like “drinking from a firehose”—you’ll absorb knowledge quickly and consistently, experiencing tremendous growth. Joy is committed to personally ensuring you reach your full potential as an Ecommerce Manager, supporting your journey every step of the way.

ORIENTATION

  • This role will be client-facing.

WHAT’S IN IT FOR ME?

SALARY RANGE

  • First month: $2,000
  • Second month: $4,000
  • Third month (on average): $7,000 a month
  • 1st Year Annual Range: $64,000-$76,000
  • 2nd Year Annual Range: $100,000-$120,000

This will depend on the amount of clients and the quality of work.

Growth, Transparency, and Fairness in Career Development

  • Progress is Clearly Defined
  • Depends primarily on your experience with the system & quality of execution against it. Following a well-defined path for the first 12 months and how exactly you can grow to be promoted to the next level.
  • Fairness and transparency are prioritized
  • Access a weekly performance dashboard to see exactly where you stand compared to team members on both objective and subjective metrics.
  • Pay transparency is upheld for all team members
  • With consistent contract terms and a clear roadmap for increasing earnings, ensuring everyone understands the path to greater compensation. We will also talk monthly about how you can progress.
  • My Commitment to You:
  • You will work harder, learn more than ever before, and “make more than you ever have.” You will gain a diverse skill set while actively contributing to the continuous development of new tools and improvements within our system. In doing so you will have an incredible opportunity for rapid career progression.
  • We will continue to provide you mentorship through every step of your development in the role and promotion from it. We will then continue to provide feedback against the expectation and evaluate against it.
  • Fully remote with the ability to pick your schedule.
  • Embrace autonomy as a core value, with clear expectations, regular 1:1 feedback sessions, and measurable quality benchmarks to support personal growth. Exceptional work is recognized and rewarded, with weekly check-ins for accountability, ensuring you’re consistently challenged and engaged with new opportunities daily.

Overview

About Acadia Pharmaceuticals
Acadia is advancing breakthroughs in neuroscience to elevate life. Since our founding, we have been working at the forefront of healthcare to bring vital solutions to people who need them most. We developed and commercialized the first and only FDA-approved drug to treat hallucinations and delusions associated with Parkinson's disease psychosis, and the first and only approved drug in the United States and Canada for the treatment of Rett syndrome. Our clinical-stage development efforts are focused on Prader-Willi syndrome, Alzheimer's disease psychosis, and multiple other programs targeting neuro-psychiatric and neuro-rare diseases. For more information, visit Acadia.com and follow us on LinkedIn and X.

Seeking talent near: Arlington, VA; Jefferson, VA

Position Summary

The Neuroscience Sales Specialist is responsible for achieving sales goals within the assigned territory by building strong customer relationships, delivering compliant and compelling product education, and driving appropriate patient access. This role requires expertise in neuroscience, deep knowledge of the local healthcare landscape, and the ability to partner effectively with healthcare professionals (HCPs) and key stakeholders to deliver meaningful value and service.

Primary Responsibilities

  • Promote Acadia products to HCPs in person and virtually, providing clinical, disease state, and reimbursement information in a compliant and customer-focused manner.
  • Develop and execute a territory business plan to meet or exceed sales objectives, leveraging market data, customer insights, and quarterly action plans.
  • Establish and maintain strong relationships with HCPs, including key opinion leaders, advocacy organizations, and other healthcare stakeholders.
  • Address customer questions, concerns, and objections using advanced dialogue and selling skills.
  • Tailor approved sales aids, clinical reprints, and brand resources to meet specific customer needs.
  • Partner with internal colleagues (e.g., managed markets, operations, sales training, marketing) to deliver coordinated solutions.
  • Provide guidance on product pricing, reimbursement, and specialty distribution channels, acting as a liaison between customers and the Company for access-related issues.
  • Accurately track and report sales activities, business expenses, and customer interactions in a timely manner.
  • Represent Acadia at conferences, exhibits, and trainings; participate in national, regional, and local meetings as required.
  • Mentor and train new sales specialists as needed, and contribute to cross-functional projects and field strategic insights.

Knowledge & Expertise

  • Deep understanding of neuroscience disease states, Acadia products, and local/regional market dynamics.
  • Ability to serve as a trusted resource in the medical community.
  • Proficiency in Microsoft Office and virtual engagement platforms (e.g., Zoom, WebEx).
  • Strong grasp of payer dynamics, including Part D and specialty pharmacy/hub distribution.

Qualifications

  • Education: Bachelor's degree required; life sciences preferred.
  • Experience:
    • Sales Specialist : Minimum 1+ years of sales experience in pharmaceutical/healthcare; neuroscience preferred.
    • Senior Specialist : Minimum 5+ years of healthcare sales (2+ in complex/account-based selling).
  • Demonstrated advanced selling skills, leadership abilities, and business acumen.
  • Proven success in influencing diverse HCP audiences across multiple care settings.
  • Strong interpersonal, communication, and negotiation skills.
  • Ability to work independently, adapt to change, and deliver consistently high results.
  • Must reside within the territory (or within 30 miles of its border) and possess a valid driver's license with an acceptable driving record.
  • Ability to meet travel requirements, including significant driving and overnight stays; air travel as needed.
  • Must comply with vaccination requirements for HCP office access, long-term care facilities, and medical conferences.

Scope

Applies broad experience and professional judgment to address complex business challenges, using creativity and data-driven decision-making to achieve results in a highly regulated environment.

Physical Requirements

This role involves regular standing, walking, sitting, and the use of hands for handling or operating equipment. The employee may also need to reach, climb, balance, stoop, kneel, crouch, and maintain visual, verbal, and auditory communication both in a standard office environment and while working independently from remote locations. Employee must occasionally lift and/or move up to 20 pounds. This position requires the ability to travel independently overnight and/or work after hours as required by travel schedule or business needs.

Must reside within the territory (or within 30 miles of its border) and, depending on territory needs, within reasonable proximity to a major airport. Requires eligibility to drive a company vehicle and ability to travel independently by air. Travel may be up to 80% of the time, including occasional after-hours work based on business needs.

Position levels

  • Sales Specialist : $115,000.00 - requires 1+ years of sales experience with at least 1 year in pharmaceutical, and/or other related healthcare sales, with an emphasis on neuroscience preferred.
  • Sales Specialist : $135,000.00 - requires a minimum of 5+ years of healthcare sales with at least 2 years of experience in complex or account-based selling environments is required.

Canonical is a leading provider of open source software and operating systems to the global enterprise and technology markets. You will enjoy this role if you are organized, persistent, charismatic and hard-working. You will need to be interested in tech and its business implications. What we offer colleagues
We consider geographical location, experience, and performance in shaping compensation worldwide. We revisit compensation annually (and more often for graduates and associates) to ensure we recognize outstanding performance. In addition to base pay, we offer a performance-driven annual bonus or commission. We provide all team members with additional benefits which reflect our values and ideals.   • Distributed work environment with twice-yearly team sprints in person

Canonical is a pioneering tech firm at the forefront of the global move to open source. As the company that publishes Ubuntu, one of the most important open-source projects and the platform for AI, IoT, and the cloud, we are changing the world of software. We recruit on a global basis and set a very high standard for people joining the company. We expect excellence; in order to succeed, we need to be the best at what we do. Most colleagues at Canonical have worked from home since our inception in 2004. Working here is a step into the future and will challenge you to think differently, work smarter, learn new skills, and raise your game.
Canonical is an equal opportunity employer
We are proud to foster a workplace free from discrimination. Diversity of experience, perspectives, and background create a better work environment and better products. Whatever your identity, we will give your application fair consideration.

title: Pessoa Arquiteta de Soluções, Startup
description:
Você gosta de startups? Tem interesse em computação em nuvem? Temos uma posição para você.
As startups são as grandes empresas do futuro. Estas jovens empresas são fundadas por pessoas ambiciosas que desejam construir algo significativo e desafiar o status quo seja para atender novos clientes ou para desafiar os atuais. Geralmente operam em um ambiente de escassez: seja de capital, recursos de engenharia ou experiência. É aqui que você entra.
A equipe de arquitetura de soluções de inicialização da AWS se dedica a trabalhar com essas empresas que estão em estágio inicial à medida que elas constroem seus negócios. Estamos aqui para garantir que eles possam implantar as melhores, mais escaláveis e mais seguras arquiteturas possíveis – e que gastem o mínimo de tempo e dinheiro possível fazendo isso.
Procuramos construtoras técnicas que amam a ideia de trabalhar com startups em estágio inicial para ajudá-las à medida que crescem. Nesta função, você trabalhará diretamente com clientes interessantes e os ajudará a tomar as melhores (e às vezes mais pragmáticas) decisões técnicas ao longo do caminho. Você terá a oportunidade de construir relacionamentos duradouros com essas empresas e se estabelecer como um consultor confiável.
Temos mais de 200 serviços em diversas categorias diferentes e é importante que possamos ajudar as startups a aproveitar as vantagens dos serviços certos. Você também desempenhará um papel importante como defensora de nossas equipes de produtos para garantir que estamos construindo os produtos certos para as startups com as quais você trabalha. E para os clientes com os quais você não trabalha individualmente, terá a oportunidade de compartilhar seu conhecimento de forma mais ampla, trabalhando em conteúdo técnico e apresentando-se em eventos.

Key job responsibilities
- Envolver-se diretamente com pessoas clientes iniciantes para fornecer-lhes apoio técnico à medida que constroem seus produtos na nuvem. Certifique-se de que eles estão gastando o mínimo de tempo e dinheiro possível fazendo isso;
- Criar planos, em conjunto com outros membros das equipes de contas do cliente, para definir como você ajudará as pessoas clientes com suas necessidades de nuvem;
- Compartilhar amplamente seu conhecimento técnico participando de sessões selecionadas, focadas em startups, com uma pessoa e em grupos maiores de clientes;
- Trabalhar com outras equipes na AWS (por exemplo, marketing, treinamento) para contribuir para a criação de conteúdo que possa ser entregue à comunidade mais ampla de startups em escala (por exemplo, vídeos on-line e outros conteúdos digitais).
A day in the life
Como membro do líder mundial para este espaço empolgante e de crescimento rápido, você terá a oportunidade de ajudar a impulsionar o crescimento e moldar o futuro de uma categoria de serviço que terá um impacto significativo em nossos clientes de modelo global de computação. Nossa equipe valoriza muito o equilíbrio entre vida pessoal e profissional. Não se trata de quantas horas você passa em casa ou no trabalho: é sobre o fluxo que você estabelece que traz energia para ambas as partes da sua vida. Acreditamos que encontrar o equilíbrio certo entre sua vida pessoal e profissional seja fundamental para a felicidade e a realização ao longo da vida. Oferecemos flexibilidade no horário de trabalho e encorajamos você a encontrar seu próprio equilíbrio entre o trabalho e a vida pessoal.
About the team
Aqui na AWS, abraçamos nossas diferenças. Estamos empenhados em promover nossa cultura de inclusão. Temos dez grupos de afinidade liderados por funcionários, alcançando 40.000 funcionários em mais de 190 capítulos globalmente. Temos ofertas de benefícios inovadores e hospedamos experiências de aprendizado anuais e contínuas, incluindo nossas conferências Conversations on Race and Ethnicity (CORE) e AmazeCon (diversidade de gênero). A cultura de inclusão da Amazon é reforçada em nossos 16 Princípios de Liderança, que lembram os membros da equipe a buscarem diversas perspectivas, aprenderem e serem curiosos e ganharem confiança.
About the team
Experiências Diversas
A AWS valoriza experiências diversas. Mesmo que você não atenda a todas as qualificações e habilidades preferenciais listadas na descrição do cargo, incentivamos os candidatos a se candidatarem. Se sua carreira está apenas começando, não seguiu um caminho tradicional ou inclui experiências alternativas, não deixe que isso o impeça de se candidatar.
Por que a AWS?
A Amazon Web Services (AWS) é a plataforma de nuvem mais abrangente e amplamente adotada do mundo. Fomos pioneiros na computação em nuvem e nunca paramos de inovar — é por isso que os clientes, desde as startups mais bem-sucedidas até as empresas da Global 500, confiam em nosso robusto conjunto de produtos e serviços para impulsionar seus negócios.
Cultura de Equipe Inclusiva
Aqui na AWS, está em nossa natureza aprender e ser curiosos. Nossos grupos de afinidade liderados por funcionários promovem uma cultura de inclusão que nos permite ter orgulho de nossas diferenças. Eventos e experiências de aprendizado contínuos nos inspiram a nunca parar de abraçar nossa singularidade.
Mentoria e Crescimento Profissional
Estamos continuamente elevando nosso padrão de desempenho enquanto nos esforçamos para nos tornar o Melhor Empregador da Terra. É por isso que você encontrará aqui compartilhamento de conhecimento sem fim, mentoria e outros recursos para o avanço da carreira para ajudá-lo a se desenvolver como um profissional mais completo.
Equilíbrio entre Trabalho e Vida Pessoal
Valorizamos a harmonia entre trabalho e vida pessoal. Alcançar o sucesso no trabalho nunca deve vir às custas de sacrifícios em casa, por isso buscamos flexibilidade como parte de nossa cultura de trabalho. Quando nos sentimos apoiados no local de trabalho e em casa, não há nada que não possamos alcançar.

- Diploma de bacharel
- Experiência em vendas de tecnologia/software, pré-vendas ou consultoria
- Conhecimento dos serviços AWS
- Capacidade de comunicar em ambiente empresarial em inglês e português

- Fortes habilidades de comunicação verbal e escrita
- Experiência na comunidade de startups (por exemplo, fundador, mentor, funcionário técnico inicial)

- Paixão por aprender e ajudar os outros a aprenderem

Job description

A Funcional Health Tech acredita que a saúde é o pilar principal da vida das pessoas, por isso, quebramos barreiras para promovê-la de forma sustentável.

Para realizar nosso propósito, inovamos todos os dias, unindo pessoas, tecnologia e dados para prover o ecossistema da saúde com soluções que geram eficiência e sustentabilidade em toda a cadeia.

Aqui, você participará, de maneira direta ou indireta, da criação de novas soluções para os mais diversos serviços de saúde, pois essa é a missão diária de todos nós na Funcional. Pesquisamos, criamos e fazemos acontecer, pois isso está em nosso DNA.

Main responsibilities

Sua missão como Analista de Ciências de Dados será:

  • Desenvolver análises estatísticas e modelos preditivos para identificar padrões de comportamento e apoiar decisões estratégicas.
  • Estruturar hipóteses de negócio e validar estatisticamente seus impactos.
  • Explorar e tratar grandes volumes de dados de saúde, garantindo qualidade e consistência.
  • Colaborar com times de engenharia de dados e visualização de dados para disponibilizar análises e modelos em escala.
  • Elaborar relatórios e apresentações que traduzam resultados complexos em insights claros para áreas de negócio.
  • Acompanhar o desempenho dos modelos estatísticos e propor melhorias contínuas.

Requirements and skills

Habilidades que esperamos que você possua:

  • Formação em Estatística, Matemática Aplicada, Ciência de Dados ou áreas correlatas.
  • Experiência prévia em análise estatística e modelagem preditiva.
  • Conhecimento sólido em estatística aplicada (testes de hipóteses, regressões, modelos probabilísticos);
  • Linguagens de programação: Python (pandas, scikit-learn, statsmodels) e R;
  • SQL para manipulação de bases de dados relacionais.

Diferenciais que vão fazer você chamar nossa atenção:

  • Experiência no setor de saúde será um diferencial (dados de operadoras, indústria farmacêutica ou varejo farmacêutico).
  • Noções de machine learning avançado e técnicas de modelagem preditiva.
  • Experiência com ambientes em nuvem (AWS, GCP ou Azure).
  • Conhecimento em boas práticas de versionamento de código (Git).

Additional information

Como é trabalhar aqui na Funcional Health Tech:

  • Nosso time é incrível, colaboramos e fazemos juntos para ir mais longe.
  • Nossa cultura é ágil e estamos em constante evolução.
  • Incentivamos o crescimento profissional e o desenvolvimento dos nossos colaboradores com diversas ações e encontros, através de plataforma de treinamentos e webinars mensais, além da “Baratona”, que é o nosso Hackathon interno.

A Funcional reconhece que a diversidade traz benefícios para o negócio e que um ambiente plural e colaborativo é propício para a inovação acontecer. Desta forma, nossas oportunidades abraçam todos os talentos, sem distinção de cor, raça, gênero ou qualquer condição de deficiência.
